_experiment: E-H2 -- the (lambda, tau) prior-strength sweep, q=256 always
_estimator: paired_episode_cluster_bootstrap (B=2000, unit = episode cluster). NEVER overlapping_holdout_se.

planted.why: argmin (1.0, 0.25) is interior and separated-better than the shipped lambda=1/tau=1 cell by +0.0244 m

degenerate.why: the prior does not move the pick anywhere on the grid (total spread 0.000e+00 m) -- there is no axis to optimise

saturated.why: the argmin (0.25, 0.1) is 100% clamp-bound and numerically TIED with lambda=[0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 8.0] at the same tau -- lambda is a no-op there, so the 'optimum' is an artefact of seam_clamp, not a located optimum (6/7 cells in this row are fully clamp-bound). Read the diagnostic sheet

unpowered.why: argmin (8.0, 0.1) beats the shipped cell by only +0.0100 m, CI [-0.0260, +0.0062] includes zero -- a null at n=40 episodes is UNPOWERED, not refuted

selftest._read: the rule returns a FAILING verdict on three fixtures built to fail and the PASSING verdict on one built to pass. A harness that can only ever return PASS has not been validated.
selftest._what_makes_it_FAIL_on_real_data: DEGENERATE if the grafts were still at their ReZero zero-init; SATURATED if seam_clamp=1.0 pins every lambda cell (the named trap); UNPOWERED if the best cell's paired CI vs lambda=1/tau=1 includes zero at n=40 episodes; NO-INTERIOR if the argmin lands on lambda=0/8 or tau=0.1/4.
